CALL TO ORDER

The City Council meeting was called to order on Tuesday, January 24, 2023 at 6:04 PM.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, provided brief information regarding the conduct of the meeting.

Mayor Del Rio asked for a Moment of Silence for the victims of the mass shooting in Monterey Park.

E.  NEW BUSINESS

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that Tuesday, February 28,
2023 is Student Government Day; and March 21­26 The Wall That Heals is visiting the city at Fedde
Middle School;

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, announced that CDD is hosting an information
workshop for property owners on how to become participants in the Section 8 program on
Thursday, January 26, 2023.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, announced that on January 16, 2023, the CDBG funded
Street Rehabilitation Project Plan Specifications and Estimates were approved and the project is ready
for advertisement in February 2023; and that the ATP Cycle 6 application was approved for funding for
implementing a Bike Master Plan.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember De Paula appreciation the collaboration we have at the County level with CalTrans for
cleaning up graffiti; and extended condolences to the families of the victims of the Monterey Park
shooting.

I.  CLOSED SESSION

1.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Significant exposure to litigation pursuant to the provisions of Government Code Section
  54956.9(d)(2) and (e)(3) with regard to one potential case. The City received a letter from Matt
  Gelfand, counsel for Californians for Homeownership, dated December 21, 2022, relating to the
  status of the City’s Housing Element, which is available for public inspection at the City Clerk’s
  office at 21815 Pioneer Blvd., Hawaiian Gardens, California, during normal City Hall business
  hours.

  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, read the Closed Session Item into the record.

  The City Council recessed to Closed Session at 6:39 PM.

  The City Council reconvened from Closed Session at 7:35 PM.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, conducted a roll call and announced a quorum.

  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, stated no reportable action from Closed Session.

J.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 7:35 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Tuesday, February 14, 2023 at 6:00 PM.
